name: ncurses

commands.command:
make DESTDIR=$PWD/dest install
sed -e 's/^#if.*XOPEN.*$/#if 1/' \
    -i dest/usr/include/curses.h
cp --remove-destination -av dest/* /

for lib in ncurses form panel menu ; do
    ln -sfv lib${{lib}}w.so /usr/lib/lib${{lib}}.so
    ln -sfv ${{lib}}w.pc    /usr/lib/pkgconfig/${{lib}}.pc
done

description: The Ncurses package contains libraries for terminal-independent handling of character screens.

installed_descriptions.name: captoinfo
installed_descriptions.description: Converts a termcap description into a terminfo description

installed_descriptions.name: infocmp
installed_descriptions.description: Compares or prints out terminfo descriptions

installed_descriptions.name: infotocap
installed_descriptions.description: Converts a terminfo description into a termcap description

installed_descriptions.name: reset
installed_descriptions.description: Reinitializes a terminal to its default values

installed_descriptions.name: tabs
installed_descriptions.description: Clears and sets tab stops on a terminal

installed_descriptions.name: tic
installed_descriptions.description: The terminfo entry-description compiler that translates a terminfo file from source format into the binary format needed for the ncurses library routines [A terminfo file contains information on the capabilities of a certain terminal.]

installed_descriptions.name: toe
installed_descriptions.description: Lists all available terminal types, giving the primary name and description for each

installed_descriptions.name: tput
installed_descriptions.description: Makes the values of terminal-dependent capabilities available to the shell; it can also be used to reset or initialize a terminal or report its long name

installed_descriptions.name: tset
installed_descriptions.description: Can be used to initialize terminals

installed_descriptions.name: libncursesw
installed_descriptions.description: Contains functions to display text in many complex ways on a terminal screen; a good example of the use of these functions is the menu displayed during the kernel's make menuconfig

installed_descriptions.name: libncurses++w
installed_descriptions.description: Contains C++ binding for other libraries in this package

abi5-compatibility.description: Build and install non-wide-character ABI version 5 compatibility libraries for binary-only applications or LSB compatibility.

commands.command:
make distclean
./configure --prefix=/usr    \
            --with-shared    \
            --without-normal \
            --without-debug  \
            --without-cxx-binding \
            --with-abi-version=5
make sources libs
cp -av lib/lib*.so.5* /usr/lib
